info.title: mc-api-server
info.description:
Lightweight HTTP wrapper for managing Minecraft server instances, the
remote backend for minecraft-bot.

Generated from the router by `npm run openapi:generate`. Do not edit by hand.

Every route except `GET /health` requires the `x-api-key` header. Every
non-2xx body is `{ "error": "<message>" }`. Clients negotiate by the
feature names and versions in `GET /manifest`, not by wrapper version.

post.description: Refused unless the server is offline, judged by a probe made now. The path handed to the restore script is the one the wrapper resolved from the id. A script that ran returns 200 with its output and exit code.

get.description: What start.sh recorded: JVM started and exited, restart scheduled, crash loop gave up. Read with a byte-offset cursor: pass the previous `next` as `since`. `reset` means the file was rotated and this read starts from its beginning.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Byte offset from the previous reply; default 0.

get.description: Process liveness and RCON responsiveness reported separately, plus systemd restart-loop detection.
The version handshake plus whole-machine CPU and memory, the server process, and per-directory disk usage.

get.summary: Live log lines as server-sent events
get.description: Holds the connection open. Each log line is one `data:` event; comment lines (`:heartbeat`) keep idle connections alive.

get.summary: The end of the server log

get.description: Disabled mods are left out: they are not on the running server.

post.description: Runs the suite's add-mod script. A handled failure is `{ ok: false, error, code }` at 200.

post.summary: Disable a mod without uninstalling it
Start a mod compatibility check for a Minecraft version
post.description: Checks every installed mod for a release on `mcVersion` and the installed loader, in the background. One job runs per version: a second request returns the running job. A finished answer is reused for six hours unless `refresh` is set (body or `?refresh=1`) or a mod changed.

get.summary: Progress and result of a mod compatibility check
get.description: Finished jobs are kept for about 15 minutes; after that the job id is unknown (404) and the check can be started again.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Job id from the start request.

get.summary: Installed mods with versions and enabled state

post.summary: Delete the chunks a scan found
post.description: Runs in the background: players are warned, the server is stopped and backed up, the plan is applied (a fresh scan must still agree with at least 90 % of it), and the server is started. If the prune fails or the server does not come up, this job's own backup is restored. Poll it with `GET /operations/upgrade/:jobId`. Refused with 423 while anything else holds the instance.

423.description: Locked: another operation holds the instance

post.description: Runs the suite's upgrade job in the background: players are warned, the server is stopped and backed up, the new version and mods are installed, and the server is started and watched. If it does not come up, the mods without a build are disabled and it starts again; if that fails too, this job's own backup is restored. Refused with 423 while anything else holds the instance.

423.description: Locked: another operation holds the instance

get.summary: Progress and result of an upgrade
get.description: Finished jobs are kept for a few hours (the last five); after that the id is unknown (404).

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Job id from the start request.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Progress sequence number; only newer lines are returned.

get.summary: The running or most recent upgrade
get.description: The job this wrapper is running, else the latest one it knows, else what the script left behind (so a wrapper restart does not lose the outcome). 404 when there has been none.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Progress sequence number; only newer lines are returned.

get.description: Names and region-file counts, from directory listings only (no chunk is read), so a client can offer a choice before scanning. A scan limited to chosen dimensions reads only those.

get.summary: One chunk of a plan, in full
get.description: Reads the chunk now and reports what it contains (block entities, structures), how long players were near it, how much space it takes, whether the plan deletes it and which protections cover it. For the map's inspector; the map itself stays light.

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: Plan id from the scan summary.

get.summary: The map of one dimension of a scan
get.description: Per region, base64 bytes per chunk: its class (0 empty, 1 would be deleted, 2 busy, 3 protected, 4 buffer, 5 unreadable) and a heat level of its inhabited time. `index` is the dimension's position in the summary.

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: Plan id from the scan summary.

post.description: Reads every region file and stores a plan; changes nothing and is safe on a running server (the answer is approximate while chunks are being written). Without a body the saved settings are used. One scan runs at a time.

get.summary: Progress and result of a prune scan
get.description: The summary appears once `state` is `done`. The last few scans are kept.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Job id from the start request.

post.description: A scan only reads, so stopping it is safe; what it already read stays cached for the next scan. The job then reports `failed` with error `cancelled`.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Job id from the start request.

get.description: What a scan uses when none are given. Defaults until saved.

put.description: Values are clamped to their limits by the setup suite; the reply is what was stored.

get.description: The engine version, and `unfinishedApply` when a delete started and never finished (the world may be half pruned; restore the job's backup).

A 512 x 512 PNG, one pixel per block, of the region's terrain (no biome tint). Drawn when first asked for and cached by the region file's fingerprint, so an edited region gets a new picture. Chunks that cannot be read, or predate Minecraft 1.18, are transparent. At most two tiles are drawn at once per instance. Supports If-None-Match.

parameters.name: if-none-match
parameters.description: The ETag of a tile already held.

get.summary: Whether the server process is up
get.description: Legacy boolean. True for `online` and `unresponsive`; read /health to tell them apart.

post.summary: Run one of the suite's management scripts
post.description: A script that ran returns 200 with its output and exit code, including a non-zero exit. Only a failure to run it is a 500.

get.summary: Uuids that have a stats file

stats.description: A player's stats file, verbatim from the game.

get.summary: Every player's stats in one response

additionalProperties.description: A player's stats file, verbatim from the game.

get.description: `tps` is null when the server did not report one.

get.description: The route list is collected from the router at boot. Clients negotiate by feature name and version rather than by wrapper version.

get.summary: Request counters, timings and cache statistics

upgrade.description: update/upgrade.sh exists, so the version upgrade job can run.

prune.description: world/prune-chunks.js exists, so chunks can be pruned.

command.description: At most 1400 bytes, no control characters.

CommandResult.description: `via` names the channel that carried the command. `result` is the console's reply, or `null` over the screen fallback, which has no reply channel. `rconError` is set when RCON failed and the screen fallback was used instead. A command neither channel could deliver is a 502, never a 200.

format.description: File type by extension: toml, json, json5, properties, cfg, conf, ini, yaml, text or snbt.

editable.description: False when the file is listed but cannot be read or written.

items.description: One event: ts, type (jvm_start, jvm_exit, restart_scheduled, crash_loop_gave_up) and its fields.

reset.description: The file was rotated; this is a read from its start.

Manifest.description: What this wrapper serves; see src/contracts/manifest.ts.

ModAddResult.description: Result of add-mod.js. A handled failure is `{ ok: false, error, code }` at 200.

ModCompatJob.description: A mod compatibility check. `checkedAt`, `complete`, `summary` and `mods` are present once `state` is `done`; `error` when it is `failed`.

partial.description: Results so far while running; empty once finished.

complete.description: True when every mod got a definitive answer (no `unknown`). Set once done.

ModCompatStarted.description: The job to poll for the result.

OperationBusy.description: Another operation holds the instance. Try again when it finishes.

kind.description: What holds the instance: stop, backup, restore, mods, upgrade, ...

jobId.description: Set when the holder is a job that can be polled.

PlayerList.description: `playerCount` and `maxPlayers` are strings; maxPlayers is "?" when unknown.

present.description: Whether the world has this chunk at all.

readable.description: False when the chunk exists but cannot be read; it is then never deleted.

plannedForDeletion.description: Whether this plan deletes the chunk.

unexplained.description: Block entities that no structure or spawner explains.

delete.description: Everything that would go: what the rules found plus what was chosen by hand.

uncertain.description: Kept by build protection: the rules would delete them but they hold things a structure does not explain.

manualSoft.description: Chosen by hand over a soft rule (in use, buffer); part of delete.

manualHard.description: Chosen by hand over a hard protection; part of delete.

manualBlocked.description: Chosen by hand but kept: unreadable, or protected without the override.

PruneMap.description: One dimension of a plan, for drawing the map.

regions.description: Per region (r.X.Z): base64 cell classes and heat levels, 1024 bytes each.

thresholdMinutes.description: Chunks inhabited for less than this many minutes are candidates.

spawnRadiusChunks.description: Chunks around the world spawn that are never pruned.

playerRadiusChunks.description: Chunks around each player's last position that are never pruned.

bufferChunks.description: Candidates this close to anything that stays are kept.

zones.description: Protected rectangles, in chunk coordinates, inclusive.

dimensions.description: Dimension ids to scan; null means every one found.

buildProtection.description: likely: keep chunks the rules would delete when they hold block entities no structure explains (chests, signs, furnaces, beds, redstone parts, modded blocks). off: ignore what chunks contain.

planId.description: A plan id from a finished scan.

countdownSeconds.description: Warning before the stop; default 30, at most 600.

error.description: A fixed reason code when the scan failed (`cancelled` when it was stopped).

ops.description: Rectangles in chunk coordinates, inclusive, applied in order: add chooses chunks, remove takes them out again. Chosen chunks are deleted even where a soft rule (in use, buffer) would keep them. Unreadable chunks are never deleted.

allowProtected.description: Also let the selection override spawn, player areas and drawn zones.

id.description: The plan id; pass it to the prune to apply exactly this preview.

ScriptResult.description: A script that ran. A non-zero exit is still a 200.

args.description: Up to five arguments of letters, digits, `.`, `@`, `_` and `-`.

next.description: Pass as `since` to get only newer events.

error.description: busy, failed or interrupted when there is no result.

mcVersion.description: The Minecraft version to move to.

prunePlan.description: A stored prune plan id to apply after the install, before the first start.

expectUnavailable.description: The mods a compatibility check reported as unavailable. The job refuses to start if the installed set no longer gives the same list.

countdownSeconds.description: Warning before the stop; default 30, at most 600.

branch.description: How a successful upgrade got there.

archive.description: Name of the backup this job took.

disabled.description: Mods moved to mods/disabled/ to get the server up.

keptOnOldBuild.description: Mods running on a build made for an older version.

reason.description: Why it failed: apply_failed, prune_failed, crash_loop, timeout, backup_failed, ...
